image_description: An underwater close-up shot of a large cetacean, specifically focusing on the head and anterior body. The skin is dark grey/black with distinctive white mottling and patches consistent with barnacle encrustation. A broad pectoral flipper is visible in the foreground. The lighting is dim, typical of deep water, with some particulate matter suspended in the blue-green water.
